sections.section: ORDER - President's Order 28, Gift Tax (Repeal) Order 1985
sections.description:
PRESIDENT'S ORDER 28 OF 1985
PRESIDENT'S ORDER
28 OF 1985
GIFT TAX (REPEAL)
ORDER, 1985
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 3rd September, 1985]
No. F. 17
(3)/85-Pub.-The following Order, made by the President, is hereby published for
general information.
In pursuance
of the Proclamation of the fifth day of July, 1977, and in exercise of all
powers enabling him in that behalf, the President is pleased to make the
following Order -
1. Short title and commencement.-(1) This order may be called the Gift Tax Act (Repeal) Order, 1985.
(2) It shall come into force at
once, and shall be deemed to have taken effect on the first day of July, 1985.
2. Repeal of Act XIV of 1963.-(1) The Gift Tax Act, 1963
(XIV of 1963), is hereby repealed.
(2) Upon the repeal of the
aforesaid Act,-
(a) all proceedings which, immediately
before such repeal, may be pending before the authorities appointed
thereunder shall stand transferred to such officers as the Central Board of
Revenue may, by notification in the official Gazette, designate ; and
(b) all
proceedings which could have been initiated under the aforesaid Act had it not
been repealed shall be initiated by such officers as the Central Board of
Revenue may, by notification in the official Gazette, designate.
(3) Any proceedings transferred
or remanded to an officer in pursuance of clause (2) shall be disposed of by
him in accordance with the provisions of the aforesaid Act.
3. Saving.--(1) Nothing
contained in this Order shall be deemed to affect the liability of any person
to pay gift tax in respect of any gift made by him at any time before the first
day of July, 1985.
(2) Any proceedings pending
immediately before the repeal of the aforesaid Act before any gift tax
authority, the Appellate Tribunal or any Court or tribunal, or initiated
thereafter, shall be continued or, as the case may be, conducted and disposed
of as if this Order had not come into force.
